name: Select
import: import { Select, SelectTrigger, SelectValue, SelectContent, SelectItem } from "@/components/ui/select"
description: Pick one option from a list — an accessible listbox in a portal, built on Base UI.

Select.description: The root — owns the value. Compose Trigger + Content inside.

items.description: Map of value → label. Set this so the trigger shows the label (not the raw value) and typeahead works.

value.description: The value this option sets. Required.

forbidden: Do not style trigger/popup height or colors via className; use tokens.
Do not use Select for 2–3 options that fit inline; use radios or a segmented control.
Do not use Select for a boolean; use Switch or Checkbox.
Always give the trigger an accessible name — a Label or aria-label.

responsive.note: Interactive targets should remain at least 44px. Layouts should fit parent width without horizontal overflow on mobile.
